notes.title: Solitary Sentinel Has Launched on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Solitary Sentinel[/b] is now officially live on Steam! Dive into our modern roguelite reimagining of Space Invaders and experience strategic depth wrapped in minimalist visuals.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s New Since the Demo[/h3][list][*][p][b]Rescaling & Breakdown of Experience Gained[/b]
We’ve added a clear, in-game breakdown of experience earned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Solar Storm Mechanic[/b]
If no enemies fall for 60 seconds, a dynamic solar storm sweeps in, damaging both enemies and the Sentinel until one is destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Faster Firing Rates[/b]
Most weapons now fire more rapidly. Expect tighter target windows and faster-paced combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lower Upgrade Requirements[/b]
Many upgrade tiers now unlock earlier. Progress through your Sentinel’s arsenal and perks more fluidly, rewarding every wave.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Key Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Simple Yet Deep Gameplay[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.5 – Massive Upgrades & New Arsenal
notes.notes:
⚡ Version 0.5 - Massive Upgrades & New Arsenal ⚡

We’re back with v0.5, bringing upgrades, gameplay refinements, and new features:

🚀 Steam Cloud Support - Your saves are now stored in a new directory to accommodate Steam Cloud integration! Heads up: This means game progress will reset, but future backups will be seamless across devices. Still being tested.

🔥 Rebalanced Combat - Starting enemies attack faster, and your main gun fires quicker, making early encounters more thrilling than ever.

🎶 New Audio & Effects - Fresh battle music and wave start animations crank up the energy for every fight.

🖥️ Resolution Scaling Added - Play comfortably on smaller screens with the new resolution scaling feature.

⚡ Introducing: Ball Lightning Superweapon - Unleash crackling spheres of destruction, obliterating enemies with chained electric fury.

🎯 More Upgrades & Enhancements - Discover new ways to shape your loadout, fine-tune your strategy, and push deeper into battle.

Your feedback fuels these updates. Let us know what you think, and see you in the fight

notes.title: v0.4 demo release
notes.notes:
[b]Update v0.4 Is Here – More Precision, More Perks, More Chaos![/b]

Survivors, gear up! [b]v0.4[/b] brings a fresh layer of interactivity to aiming. [b]Fine-tune your shots for maximum impact[/b], or unlock the Auto-Aim perk to keep your reflexes sharp.

Enemies are evolving, and they're not staying down - introducing the [b]Resurrection trait[/b], where some foes refuse to stay defeated. Watch out for [b]new enemy animations[/b], making the battlefield feel more alive (and more terrifying).
Jump in, test out the new changes and let us know how your experience shapes up!
